gap: The compliance ledger card on Today, tv-break-dashboard/src/rules/ComplianceLedger.jsx, which P5 owns, prints the market-wide verdict as the operator's own and carries no basis line. Measured on the running product at 127.0.0.1:8083 with the shipped bundle: the card is fed by overview.compliance, and GET /api/overview returns a compliance block with no scope key at all, retention_floor violations 3,584 and break_spacing observed 7.0, while P5's own GET /api/compliance returns the same seven checks scoped to the declared channel with violations 736 and spacing 7.01, and its violations list is clean of rival names where the overview list is 136 of 200 rows naming three rivals. So the landing screen shows a compliance figure computed over 9,026 breaks on four channels, 6,635 of them a rival's, labelled as the operator's plan, and it disagrees with the licence page one click away by 4.9x on the same check with no way to see which is which. The fix is inside P5's row and is one pass: ComplianceLedger.jsx reads P5's own scoped route and keeps the prop only as a fallback, prints the scope sentence the route already returns (scope_channel, rows_out, competitor_rows_excluded) exactly as LicencePage does, and when a payload arrives with no scope key it says the basis is not stated rather than printing the numbers as the operator's. The single-line adoption owed by overview_api.py:259 and downloads_api.py:194 stays a lead item, but the card must not print an unscoped verdict as scoped while it waits.
